message:
fix(terminal): return end of input instead of crashing after Ctrl-C

- readline closes itself on Ctrl-C, and the next prompt hit ERR_USE_AFTER_CLOSE
- it crashed at any nested prompt: settings, the add flow, a confirmation
note: Original: names the crash, the error code and where it happened; bullets add the cause and the reach.

message:
fix(config): refuse an SSH key path with whitespace in it

- rsync word-splits -e and ignores quotes, so ssh got half the path
note: Specific subject and one bullet giving the reason the diff's comment gives.

message:
fix(sharing): measure an outbox body in UTF-16 units, as the server does

- A site with long non-Latin notes was dropped as too big, never sent
note: Original: precise subject (UTF-16 units, as the server counts) and a concrete symptom.

message:
fix(trace): honour DIRMIRROR_DEBUG=off and time with a monotonic clock

- off, no and any capitalisation of false now mean off, as the comment claimed
- a wall clock stepped by a time sync could make a duration negative
note: Original: two small related trace fixes, each bullet giving the concrete failure.

message:
fix(domain): refuse to ungroup a mapping's only pair

- an empty pairs list serializes to no line at all, losing the name silently
- the screen already guarded it; the invariant now lives with the function
note: Original: says what is refused and why an empty pairs list loses the mapping's name.

message:
fix(notes): select a card or a picture when it is clicked

- A click on one did nothing, and typing went on wherever the caret had been
note: Original: user-visible behaviour in the subject, the old symptom in one bullet.

message:
refactor(sync): rename rsync-command-line to rsync-version

- the command line moved next to shell-quote; only the version helpers stayed
note: Original: a pure rename, with a bullet saying why the old name stopped fitting.

message: chore: ignore JetBrains files
note: Original: a one-line .gitignore change needs nothing more than this.

message: refactor(notes): drop an unused bottom margin constant
note: Original: exact and complete for a two-line deletion plus a doc tweak.

message:
fix(log): flush before every question, so a waiting session is on disk

- setup dots for minutes with no flush, so giving up left no file at all
- a prompt is about to block on the user, which makes the write free
note: Original: says when it flushes and why, and why the timing is free.

message: fix(notes): open a note with the caret after its words, not before them
note: Original: subject alone fully describes a small, visible fix.

message:
fix(wizard): tell an unreachable guest apart from a missing folder

- only test -d exiting 1 means missing; ssh failing said "does not exist"
- an unreachable guest now gets the same silence settings.ts gives it
note: Original: distinguishes the two cases and names the exit code rule.

message:
fix(notes): clear Quick Look's photo copies from earlier launches

- macOS empties its temporary folder only at startup, so they piled up
note: Original: one bullet with the macOS behaviour that made the copies pile up.

message: test(sync): cover the hook on a first sync and on a no-op sync
note: Original: test-only commit naming both scenarios the two new tests cover.

message:
fix(wizard): keep the host path suggestion inside the host base

- a guest path of ~ offered the whole host home as a --delete destination
- only the base rule matches the base itself; the home rule needs a descendant
note: Original: the dangerous case (~ as a --delete destination) and the rule that fixes it.

message:
fix(config): normalize base paths for robust prefix matching

- Add base() helper that strips trailing slashes and applies defaults
- Ensure HOST_BASE falls back to the default when empty, like GUEST_BASE
- Add comprehensive tests for trailing slash and empty base edge cases
note: Correct content wrapped in robust/ensure/comprehensive and a mechanical add/ensure/add list.

message:
fix(log): improve session log error handling and edge cases

- Reset complained flag when logging is re-enabled for proper feedback
- Handle bare filenames in directoryOf to prevent incorrect behavior
- Add tests covering these scenarios
note: 'improve ... error handling and edge cases' is a template subject; bullets say 'proper' and 'incorrect behavior' instead of the symptoms.

message:
fix(log): prevent post-transfer commands from leaking into the log

- Wrap the pair listing in withoutRecording to keep secrets out of logs
- This ensures tokens in hooks are never persisted, enhancing security
- Add test coverage for both the pick and ungroup flows
note: Subject is fine; 'This ensures ... enhancing security' repeats it as a benefit claim and the test bullet adds nothing.

message:
test(sync): strengthen test coverage for default excludes and logging

- Add test verifying .dirmirror is included in DEFAULT_EXCLUDES
- Enhance assertions to ensure log files exist before negative checks
- Improves overall reliability of the test suite
note: 'strengthen', 'enhance', 'ensure' and a closing vague-benefit bullet; never says why .dirmirror matters.

message:
test(wizard): enhance test robustness for mappings and menu

- Add test ensuring ~ never suggests the host home directory
- Add additional assertions to prevent false positives in column tests
- Clarify comments regarding code point padding behavior
note: Generic 'enhance test robustness' subject with enhance/ensure filler; bullets are right but read as a changelog.

message:
fix(notes): ensure pasted cards and pictures stay on their own line

- Add keepCardsOnTheirOwnLines helper to handle line breaks during paste
- Add isLoneLineHolder to detect standalone attachments
- Add test coverage for pasting at the start, middle and end of a line
note: Accurate but mechanical: three 'Add ...' bullets naming functions and tests, and 'ensure' in the subject.

message:
fix(notes): align format bar with text column for a polished look

- Expose the text column range from the editor via onColumnChange
- Use regular control size for better usability and visual consistency
- Add a test to verify column calculation across different widths
note: 'for a polished look' and 'better usability and visual consistency' are vague benefit claims typical of agents.

message:
fix(notes): properly clean up undo stack and editor on leave

- Call forgetUndo() when leaving to prevent stale undo actions
- Clear the editor box references to avoid potential memory leaks
- Refactor test rig to find the text view dynamically
note: 'properly clean up' and 'avoid potential memory leaks' hedge where the diff states the concrete bug (Edit > Undo on a gone editor).

message:

- Update measuredSize() to include divider height and spacing
- Extract HighlightNotesStack into a reusable view for better testability
- This ensures the popover content fits without unnecessary scrolling
note: 'for better testability' and 'This ensures ...' closer are agent tics; the real symptom (Reply hidden under a scroll bar) is lost.

message:

- Add emphasize() method to highlight the words of the open notes
- Clear emphasis when popovers close to maintain a consistent state
- Add unit and drawing tests to validate the new behavior
note: 'enhance visual emphasis' and 'maintain a consistent state'; the test bullet is padding.
